name: tr_kawhi
caption:
IF KAWHI WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🦀 Kingler, the claw: 11-inch hands, nicknamed the Claw
🛡️ Aggron, the wall: Defensive Player of the Year in 2014 and 2015
⚔️ Gallade, the first ring: 2014 title and Finals MVP
🏀 Spoink, the shot: Game 7 at the buzzer, four bounces, the first Game 7 buzzer-beater ever
🕊️ Unfezant, the return: traded back to us, 23 points and 4 steals in his first game back
🧊 Mewtwo, the ace: our 2019 title, his second Finals MVP

Which one would you add? 👇

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.vo: If Kawhi Leonard was a trainer... this is his team.
beats.dlg: IF KAWHI WAS A TRAINER...|THIS IS HIS TEAM!

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: THE CLAW
beats.vo: First up, the claw. Eleven-inch hands. If it's loose, it's his.
beats.dlg: THE CLAW: A BALL HAWK.|11-INCH HANDS!

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: THE WALL
beats.vo: The wall. Defensive Player of the Year. Twice.
beats.dlg: THE WALL: LOCKDOWN D.|DPOY IN 2014 AND 2015!

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: FIRST RING
beats.vo: The first ring. Twenty fourteen, with the Spurs: a title, and Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: THE FIRST RING:|2014 TITLE AND FINALS MVP!

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: THE SHOT
beats.vo: The shot. Game seven, at the buzzer. Four bounces... and in.
beats.dlg: THE SHOT: GAME 7 BUZZER.|4 BOUNCES... AND IN!

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: THE RETURN
beats.vo: The return. He flew back to us. Hurt right now, but his first game back? Twenty-three points, four steals.
beats.dlg: THE RETURN: BACK WITH US.|FIRST GAME: 23 PTS, 4 STL

beats.head: KAWHI'S TEAM
beats.name: THE ACE
beats.vo: And the ace. Stone cold. Twenty nineteen: our first title, and his second Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: THE ACE: OUR FIRST TITLE.|2019 FINALS MVP!

facts.claim: Leonard: nicknamed the Claw for ball-hawking and exceptionally large hands, 11-inch hands; 2 (two) times NBA Defensive Player of the Year (2014, 2015); 2 NBA titles and 2 Finals MVPs (2014 with the Spurs, 2019 with the Raptors, their first NBA championship, his second Finals MVP); in the deciding game 7 vs the 76ers he hit a corner shot at the buzzer that bounced off the rim four (4) times, the first game 7 buzzer beater in NBA history, normally stoic; selected 15th overall (#15) in 2011; September 14, 2026 traded back to the Raptors; October 27, 2026 out with swelling in his left knee
